messages:
marie (AE): HelioCore execs asked for a firm POC plan + reserved-capacity quote. EU-only data, BYOK optional, SOC2 + KMS attestation needed. They want numbers by Friday or they'll request an exec bridge.

jason (SE): Need workload sketch (avg/peak RPS, seq len distribution, sample prompts). Also target p95 SLA.

marie (AE): 50 RPS sustained, 150 RPS peak, p95 <200ms. Will send sample prompts.

elena (Eng-Infra): Feasible on Dedicated (A10G). BYOK adds key steps. We need corpus to size KV cache. Will draft runbook.

priya (RevOps): Pricing ask: 20% for 3-month commit. Standard short-commit cap ~10%. Recommend 12% + onboarding credit to avoid exec ask.

rachel (Legal): I'll prepare a CDA addendum + minimal checklist (CDA, KMS decision, peering CIDR, log retention).

marie (AE): Tasks: @jason -> payloads tonight; @elena -> sizing & runbook by tomorrow 12:00 UTC; @priya -> pricing scenarios by tomorrow 15:00 UTC; @rachel -> CDA draft ASAP. If CDA not signed by Fri, escalate to exec bridge @noah.

noah (CTO): I can join a bridge Mon morning if needed. Keep me posted.

marie (AE): Thanks team. I'll update HelioCore after we have numbers. :thumbsup:
